import re from typing import List def parse_html_tags(html: str) -> List[str]: """ Extract all HTML tags from the input string. Parameters ---------- html : str The input HTML content to be parsed. Returns ------- List[str] A list of tag strings, e.g. ['
', '

']. """ # Use a non-greedy pattern to match tags and avoid spanning multiple tags tag_pattern = re.compile(r'<[^>]+>', flags=re.IGNORECASE) try: tags = tag_pattern.findall(html or "") except Exception: # pragma: no cover # In case of any unexpected error, return an empty list instead of raising. tags = [] return tags
